# Algo FM
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/algosynth

FM-style algorithmic synthesizer with 4 operators and 8 modulation algorithms.

**Active runtime:** Daisy WASM (`algovoice` in `zss_voice.cpp`) implements the same 8 routings below. FM depth matches Tone: `carrier_hz += (note_hz * modindex) * modulator` (enveloped op). `#synth osc1`–`osc4` set each operator wave. Select with `#synth algo0` … `#synth algo7`.

Solid arrows below are **audio** into the mix. Dashed arrows are **FM** into another operator’s frequency.

## Overview

Each operator has its own oscillator and envelope. Harmonicity scales op1–op3 vs the note; modindex scales FM depth on the dashed links.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  note[noteHz]
  note --> harm1[harmonicity1]
  note --> harm2[harmonicity2]
  note --> harm3[harmonicity3]
  note --> op4[op4]
  harm1 --> op1[op1]
  harm2 --> op2[op2]
  harm3 --> op3[op3]
  op1 -.->|modindex1| op2
  op2 -.->|modindex2| op3
  op3 -.->|modindex3| op4
  op4 --> mix[out]
```

That sketch is the classic serial chain (algo 0). Other algorithms change which ops modulate which, and which ops are mixed to the output.

## Algorithm reference

| Algo | Modulation | Output |
|------|------------|--------|
| 0 | 1→2→3→4 serial | op4 |
| 1 | 1,2→3→4 | op4 |
| 2 | 1→4, 2→3→4 | op4 |
| 3 | 1,2,3→4 | op4 |
| 4 | 1→2, 3→4 | op2 + op4 |
| 5 | 1→2, 1→3, 1→4 | op2 + op3 + op4 |
| 6 | 1→2 | op2 |
| 7 | none (additive) | op1 + op2 + op3 + op4 |

### algo0 — serial stack

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  op1[op1] -.-> op2[op2]
  op2 -.-> op3[op3]
  op3 -.-> op4[op4]
  op4 --> outNode[out]
```

### algo1 — dual into 3→4

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  op1[op1] -.-> op3[op3]
  op2[op2] -.-> op3
  op3 -.-> op4[op4]
  op4 --> outNode[out]
```

### algo2 — side carrier + stack

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  op1[op1] -.-> op4[op4]
  op2[op2] -.-> op3[op3]
  op3 -.-> op4
  op4 --> outNode[out]
```

### algo3 — three into carrier

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  op1[op1] -.-> op4[op4]
  op2[op2] -.-> op4
  op3[op3] -.-> op4
  op4 --> outNode[out]
```

### algo4 — dual FM pairs

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  op1[op1] -.-> op2[op2]
  op3[op3] -.-> op4[op4]
  op2 --> outNode[out]
  op4 --> outNode
```

### algo5 — one modulator, three carriers

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  op1[op1] -.-> op2[op2]
  op1 -.-> op3[op3]
  op1 -.-> op4[op4]
  op2 --> outNode[out]
  op3 --> outNode
  op4 --> outNode
```

### algo6 — single pair

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  op1[op1] -.-> op2[op2]
  op2 --> outNode[out]
```

### algo7 — additive

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  op1[op1] --> outNode[out]
  op2[op2] --> outNode
  op3[op3] --> outNode
  op4[op4] --> outNode
```

## Parameters (`#synth` after `algoN`)

| Parameter | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `harmonicity1`…`3` | Freq ratio for op1–op3 vs note |
| `modindex1`…`3` | FM depth on the dashed links |
| `osc1`…`osc4` | Operator wave (basic / pulse / pwm) |
| `env1`…`env4` | Per-operator ADSR |
| `env` / `port` / `vol` | Outer voice envelope, glide, level |

Player recipes: [Synth voices](/synth/voices#algo-fm-algo0algo7).

---

# Main chain
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/audiochain

Builds the global audio routing and processing chain for the synth.

## Signal Flow

```
playvolume ─────┐
               │
bgplayvolume ──┼──► sidechaincompressor ──► mix ──► maincompressor ──► razzle ──► destination
ttsvolume ─────┤         ▲                  │
               │         │                  │
drumvolume ────┴─────────┼──────────────────┘
                         │
drumaction ──────────────┘
altaction (SC key) ──────┘
hiss (in razzle) ─────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

Stem faders (`readplayvolume` / `readbgplayvolume` / `readttsvolume` / `readdrumvolume`) scale each bus into the mix. `#vol` scales play/bg/tts via effective SAB trims and drums via SAB VOL. Razzle is post-compressor bed only (not a master fader).

## Components

### Main Compressor

- **Threshold:** -28 dB (Tone product)
- **Ratio:** 4:1
- **Attack / release:** 3 ms / 150 ms (RMS envelope detector; Tone product release)
- **Applied gain slew:** 8 ms attack / 150 ms release (`comp_gain_smooth`, separate from detector)
- **Parallel mix:** 100% wet (`kMainCompMix = 1`)
- **Knee:** 30 dB soft knee (Tone product `Compressor`; full width around threshold via `compressorskneedb`)
- **Silence guard:** When `|dry|` is below ~-80 dBFS, `comp_env` fast-decays so gain returns to unity before the next note
- **Purpose:** Dynamics on full post-sidechain mix (ducked play + bg + TTS + drums)
- **Tone reference:** `Tone.Compressor` -28 / 4 / 3 ms / 150 ms / knee 30
- **Daisy:** `maincompressor()` — detector (`comp_env`) + smoothed multiplier (`comp_gain_smooth`); SAB slot 3 bypasses for A/B renders (`yarn notepop:render:ab`)

### Sidechain Compressor

- **Threshold:** -42 dB
- **Ratio:** 5:1
- **Attack / release:** 5 ms / 60 ms (`kScAttackSec` / `kScReleaseSec`; Tone product)
- **Mix / makeup:** 0.75 / **+24 dB** (`kScMix` / `kScMakeupDb`; Tone product)
- **Sidechain sources:** `altaction` (TTS + bgplay @ -12 dB), `drumaction` (clap+bass @ -28 dB via `kScDrumKeyDb`)
- **Purpose:** Ducks `#play` when bg/TTS/drums hit (not bg/TTS/drum buses themselves)
- **Tone:** `SidechainCompressor` AudioWorklet — input 0 = play, input 1 = summed key bus; clap/bass feed `drumaction` before kit bus gain; bass MembraneSynth volume +8 on that path
- **Daisy:** `drumsout()` taps clap ungained and bass with `kScDrumBassKeyDb` (+8) into `drumsidechain`; `sidechainkey()` then applies `kScDrumKeyDb` (−28 dB). Audible kit still uses `kDrumGains` / `kDrumBassVolumeDb`. SAB slot 4 bypasses duck (`yarn sidechain:render:ab`, `?no_sc=1`). SAB slot 5 mutes the key only (`?no_sc_key=1`) — duck stays at idle makeup, no triggers. After razzle, master **Daisy Limiter** still GR the full mix (drum peaks can pull play down), then `kMainLimiterMakeup` (~+4.3 dB) restores SoftLimit(0.7) peaks toward full scale before `clamp +/-1`; SAB slot 7 / `?no_lim=1` bypasses limiter+makeup for A/B.

### Razzle Chain

- **Vibrato:** Subtle pitch modulation (0.125 Hz, wet 0.02)
- **Chorus:** Widening effect (7 ms base delay, wet **0.25**)
- **Tape hiss:** Pink noise modulated by oscillator, feeds chorus input (very quiet bed)

Full gain chart: [gain-levels.mdx](gain-levels.mdx).

### Daisy volume laws (match Tone)

| Bus | Tone | Daisy |
|-----|------|-------|
| Play stem | playvolume fader | `readplayvolume()` (`60*log10-105`, `#playvol` × `#vol`) |
| Drums | drum bus gain | `kDrumBusGain * readdrumvolume(#vol)` |
| bgplay / TTS | `10^((60*log10(vol)-105)/20)` | `readbgplayvolume()` / `readttsvolume()` (same law) |

Boot SAB defaults: `#vol` **50**, bus trims **90** (effective **45**), TTS trim path same.

### Broadcast Destination

When not in offline mode, `broadcastdestination` is a `MediaStreamAudioDestinationNode` for screen sharing or recording the synth output.

## Exports

- `createaudiochain()` — Factory function
- `AUDIO_CHAIN` — Return type

---

# Drums
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/drums

Synthesized drum kit. Each file provides one or more drum sounds with trigger functions.

## Overview

| File | Sounds | Trigger Functions |
|------|--------|-------------------|
| index.ts | (assembles all) | All triggers |
| bass.ts | Kick | `basstrigger` |
| hihat.ts | Closed, open | `ticktrigger`, `tweettrigger` |
| snare.ts | Hi snare, low snare | `hisnaretrigger`, `lowsnaretrigger` |
| percussion.ts | Cowbell, clap | `cowbelltrigger`, `claptrigger` |
| tom.ts | Low tom | `lowtomtrigger` |
| woodblock.ts | Hi, low woodblock | `hiwoodblocktrigger`, `lowwoodblocktrigger` |

## Drum ID Mapping (from playnotation)

| ID | Drum | Trigger |
|----|------|---------|
| 0 | Tick | `ticktrigger` |
| 1 | Tweet | `tweettrigger` |
| 2 | Cowbell | `cowbelltrigger` |
| 3 | Clap | `claptrigger` |
| 4 | Hi snare | `hisnaretrigger` |
| 5 | Hi woodblock | `hiwoodblocktrigger` |
| 6 | Low snare | `lowsnaretrigger` |
| 7 | Low tom | `lowtomtrigger` |
| 8 | Low woodblock | `lowwoodblocktrigger` |
| 9 | Bass | `basstrigger` |
| 10 | Crash | `#play k` |
| 11 | Ride | `#play r` |

## Implementation

Daisy drums are custom bodies in `zss_drums.cpp`, including the tom glide and multi-harmonic bass, plus modal cymbals for crash and ride.

See [implementation-matrix.mdx](implementation-matrix.mdx) Table 4.

## Implementation Details

### bass.ts
- **MembraneSynth** with 8 octaves, pitch decay 0.125
- Connects to both `drumvolume` and `drumaction` (sidechain)
- **Daisy (ID 9):** Membrane pitch envelope + multi-harmonic body (fund/oct/sub) + soft clip; `kDrumGains[9]` trim (`kDrumBassVolumeDb` currently 0)

### hihat.ts
- **NoiseSynth** through biquad highpass filter (8kHz tick, 6kHz open; -12 dB/oct, Tone parity)
- EQ3 for tone shaping
- Short envelope for tick, longer for tweet

### snare.ts
- Oscillator (triangle) + NoiseSynth for body and snap
- Frequency ramp: 10kHz → 300/150 → 100 Hz
- Distortion for grit
- Highpass 10kHz

### percussion.ts
- **Cowbell:** PolySynth (square) at 800+540 Hz, bandpass 350Hz
- **Clap:** NoiseSynth, biquad highpass 800Hz (-12 dB/oct), EQ3 (WASM matches Tone chain; no dry blend)

### tom.ts
- Saw + triangle + noise
- Pitch glide from C4/C5 down to C0

### woodblock.ts
- Clack (saw) + donk (sine) through bandpass 256Hz
- Different frequency targets for hi vs low
- **WASM** (`drumplaycode.ts`): split clack/donk ADSR (clack decay 0.001s, donk decay 0.1s), summed before filter; voice length shortens to pattern duration + release for indices 5/8

---

# Effects
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/effects

Voice FX are **parallel sends**: dry stays full; wet is mixed beside it. Bus law: [FX bus](/synth/parallel-fx-bus).

## How sends work

| Form | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| `#echo on` / `#echo off` | Enable / mute (preset send level) |
| `#echo <0–100>` | Send amount (`0` = off) |
| `#echo delaytime …` | Effect parameter |

:::tip Isolate one effect
Turn others off, change one knob, listen. If A/B gets sticky, `#synth restart` clears FX SAB.
:::

### Which bus?

Bare `#echo`, `#reverb`, … hit **play groups 0 and 1** (all four `#play` voices). Numbered suffix picks one bus:

| Suffix | Audio |
|--------|--------|
| `*1` | `#play` voices 0–1 |
| `*2` | `#play` voices 2–3 |
| `*3` | `#bgplay` voices 4–7 |
| `*4` | TTS |

Mnemonic: `*1` = play, `*3` = bgplay. Example: `#echo3 on` for background delay only.

**`on` preset levels:** vibrato / autofilter ≈ 50; echo / reverb / fcrush / distort / autowah ≈ 18.

---

## Distort — foldback grit

Sine foldback, not soft clip. `oversample` is Tone-only — skip it on Daisy.

| Key | Default | Ear |
|-----|---------|-----|
| `distortion` | 0.4 | Fold amount — higher = harsher |

```text
#synth square
#distort off
#play hc
#distort on
#distort distortion 0.8
#play hc
```

**Expect:** clean square → folded / raspy square.

---

## Vibrato — pitch wobble

Pitch cents on the voice (not a wet delay). `#vibrato on` auto-targets depth ~0.5 when depth was ~0. Use a held note: `#play hc`.

| Key | Default | Ear |
|-----|---------|-----|
| `depth` | 0 (auto ~0.5 on `on`) | How wide the wobble |
| `frequency` | 5 | Wobble rate (Hz) |
| `maxdelay` | 0.02 (WASM) | Legacy Tone name; keep fixed while A/B depth |

```text
#synth sine
#vibrato on
#vibrato depth 0.05
#play hc
#vibrato depth 1
#play hc
```

**Expect:** almost still → obvious pitch shake. Same maxdelay both times.

---

## Autowah — envelope filter

Follower opens the filter from note energy. Needs a **run of notes** (`qceg`), not one held tone. There is **no LFO** here — that is `#autofilter`. Crank send so on/off is obvious.

| Key | Default | Ear |
|-----|---------|-----|
| `basefrequency` | 100 | Closed filter floor |
| `octaves` | 6 | How far it opens |
| `sensitivity` | −3 dB | How easily notes trigger |
| `gain` | 25 dB | Peak loudness of the wah |
| `follower` | 0.2 s | Smoothing — the “clock” of the sweep |

```text
#synth sawtooth
#autowah off
#play qceg
#autowah on
#autowah gain 30
#play qceg
```

**Expect:** dry run → vocal / quacky filter that opens on each note attack.

---

## Echo — slapback vs trails

| Key | Default | Ear |
|-----|---------|-----|
| `delaytime` | `8n` (or seconds / `4n` / `16n` …) | Time between repeats |
| `feedback` | 0.666 (clamped ≤ ~0.95) | How long the trail lasts |

### Starter: slapback

```text
#synth square
#echo on
#echo delaytime 16n
#echo feedback 0.25
#play qc eg
```

**Expect:** tight short repeats, notes still clear.

### Starter: long hall delay

```text
#echo delaytime 4n
#echo feedback 0.8
#play qc
```

**Expect:** slower echoes that hang longer.

Bgplay only: `#echo3 on` then the same params.

---

## Reverb — room wash

| Key | Default | Ear |
|-----|---------|-----|
| `decay` | 2.5 | How long the tail lasts |
| `predelay` | 0.01 | Gap before the wash starts |

### Starter: small room

```text
#synth piano
#reverb on
#reverb decay 1.2
#reverb predelay 0.01
#play qc eg
```

**Expect:** short room around the dry attack.

### Starter: big hall

```text
#reverb decay 4
#reverb predelay 0.05
#play qc
```

**Expect:** longer wash; attack still audible because dry is parallel.

---

## Frequency crush — `fcrush` / `fc`

Sample-and-hold grit.

| Key | Default | Ear |
|-----|---------|-----|
| `rate` | 32 (≥ 1) | Lower = crunchier / more aliased |

```text
#synth sawtooth
#fcrush on
#fcrush rate 64
#play hc
#fcrush rate 8
#play hc
```

**Expect:** mild lo-fi → harsh crushed tone.

---

## Autofilter — LFO sweep

LFO moves a filter (unlike autowah’s follower).

| Key | Default | Ear |
|-----|---------|-----|
| `frequency` | 3 | LFO rate (Hz) |
| `depth` | 0.5 | Sweep intensity |
| `octaves` | 5 | Sweep range |
| `q` | 1 | Resonance |
| `type` | lowpass | Biquad type ([MDN names](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/BiquadFilterNode/type)) |

```text
#synth sawtooth
#autofilter on
#autofilter frequency 1
#autofilter depth 0.8
#play hw
```

**Expect:** slow whoosh of brightness on a held note.

---

## Multi-FX together

Sends sum in parallel — order between FX types does not chain.

```text
#synth square
#echo on
#echo delaytime 8n
#echo feedback 0.4
#reverb on
#reverb decay 2.5
#play qceg
```

**Expect:** delay repeats **and** room wash, with dry attack still clear.

More routing detail: [parallel FX bus](/synth/parallel-fx-bus).

---

## Next

- [Synth voices](/synth/voices) — pick a patch
- [Notation](/synth/playnotation) — `#play` characters
- [FX bus](/synth/parallel-fx-bus) — parallel send routing

---

# Factory
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/factory

Main entry point and synth factory (`index.ts`).

## Exports

### setupsynth()

```typescript
await setupsynth()
```

One-time async initialization. Registers AudioWorklet modules:

- Frequency Crusher
- Sidechain Compressor

Call before creating synths, especially for offline rendering.

### createsynth()

```typescript
const synth = createsynth()
```

Creates and returns a full synth instance (`AUDIO_SYNTH`).

## Returned API

| Method                             | Description                          |
| ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `addplay(buffer)`                  | Parse notation and schedule playback |
| `addbgplay(buffer)`                | Schedule background SFX              |
| `stopplay()`                       | Clear scheduled notes                |
| `setmainvolume(v)`                 | Main scale for all buses (0-100)     |
| `setplayvolume(v)`                 | Play bus trim (0-100)                |
| `setbgplayvolume(v)`               | Background SFX volume                |
| `setttsvolume(v)`                  | TTS volume                           |
| `addaudiobuffer(buffer)`           | Play external audio (e.g. TTS)       |
| `applyreset()`                     | Reset all sources and FX to defaults |
| `applyreplay(source, fxchain, fx)` | Restore state for replay             |
| `synthreplay(pattern, maxtime)`    | Schedule pattern for replay          |
| `synthrecord(filename)`            | Render to MP3 and download           |
| `synthflush()`                     | Clear recording buffer               |
| `destroy()`                        | Dispose all nodes                    |

## Properties

- `SOURCE` — Array of 8 source wrappers
- `FX` — Array of 4 FX channel groups
- `FXCHAIN` — Shared effect chain
- `changesource` — Function to change source type
- `broadcastdestination` — MediaStream for capture (if not offline)

## Internal Flow

1. Creates audio chain (audiochain.ts)
2. Creates source+FX setup (sourcefxsetup.ts)
3. Creates tick handler (tickhandler.ts)
4. Schedules ticks on the Daisy engine (pacer)
5. Creates record handler (recordhandler.ts)
6. Starts pacer, applies defaults

---

# FX modules
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/fx-and-fxchannels

## Shared chain (`fx.ts`)

Shared effect chain. All voices route through these effects via FX channels.

### volumetodb(value: number)

Converts 0-100 linear scale to dB:
- 0 → ~-35 dB
- 100 → ~0 dB
- Formula: `20 * log10(value) - 35`

### createfx()

Creates Tone.js effects:
- `reverb` — Reverb
- `echo` — FeedbackDelay (8n, 0.666 feedback)
- `autofilter` — AutoFilter
- `distortion` — Distortion (4x oversample)
- `vibrato` — Vibrato
- `fc` / `fcrush` — FrequencyCrusher (rate 32)
- `autowah` — AutoWah

`getreplay()` returns state for: fc, echo, reverb, autofilter, vibrato, distortion (not autowah).

---

## Per-voice sends (`fxchannels.ts`)

Per-voice FX send/return. Each voice has a send level for each effect.

### createfxchannels(index: number)

Creates:
- **Receive channels:** fc, echo, reverb, autofilter, vibrato, distortion, autowah
- **Send node:** `sendtofx` — Connects to destination and sends to all receive buses

**Prefix:** `offline` when `context.isOffline`, else empty. Enables separate buses for offline rendering.

### Routing

```
Source ──► sendtofx ──► dest (playvolume or bgplayvolume)
    │
    └──► fc.receive ──► FXCHAIN.fc ──► dest
    └──► echo.receive ──► FXCHAIN.echo ──► dest
    ... (same for each effect)
```

Volume on each Channel controls send amount to that effect.

---

# Gain levels
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/gain-levels

Canonical inventory for the active WASM/Daisy synth. For routing narrative see
[audiochain.md](audiochain.md); for FX bus law see [parallel-fx-bus.md](parallel-fx-bus.md).

## Signal chain

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  subgraph voices [Voices]
    V0[play 0-1]
    V1[play 2-3]
    VBG[bgplay 4-7]
    DR[drums]
    TTS[tts]
  end

  V0 --> FX0["applyfxgroup 0"]
  V1 --> FX1["applyfxgroup 1"]
  VBG --> FX2["applyfxgroup 2"]

  FX0 --> PLAYSUM[play sum]
  FX1 --> PLAYSUM
  FX2 --> BG["bg x readbgplayvolume"]

  DR --> DRUM["drums x kDrumBusGain x readdrumvolume"]
  TTS --> TTSL["tts x readttsvolume"]

  PLAYSUM --> SC["sidechain duck"]
  SC --> PB["play x readplayvolume"]
  BG --> MIX
  TTSL --> MIX
  DRUM --> MIX
  PB --> MIX

  MIX --> MC[main compressor]
  MC --> RZ[razzle]
  RZ --> OUT["clamp +/-1"]
```

`#playvol` / `#bgvol` / `#ttsvol` are stem faders (SAB PLAY/BGPLAY/TTS) after `#vol` scale
(`effective = trim * vol / 100`). `#vol` is also pushed raw on SAB VOL for the drum stem.
Play, bg, tts, and drums share dB law `kBusVolDbPerDecade*log10(vol)+kBusVolOffsetDb` (**70** / **-105**). Doubling SAB (~`#vol` 50→100) is about **+21 dB**; raw `#vol` 100 ≈ **+35 dB**. Razzle is not a volume fader.

## User faders (SAB `zss_main`, 0-100)

Defined in [`wasmmainsab.ts`](../../backend/wasm/wasmmainsab.ts). Mute floor: raw `<= 0.001` -> gain `0`.
Play/bg/tts SAB values are **effective** trims: `bus * #vol / 100` (defaults: main **50**, bus trims **90** -> SAB **45**). VOL slot is raw `#vol`.

| Control | SAB slot | Trim default | dB law | Notes |
|---------|----------|--------------|--------|-------|
| `#vol` main | VOL (6) + JS scale | **50** | multiplies play/bg/tts trims; drum stem via `readdrumvolume`; board TV | Outer master |
| `#playvol` | PLAY (0) | **90** | `60*log10(vol) - 105` | Play stem (`readplayvolume`) |
| `#bgvol` | BGPLAY (1) | **90** | same | bgplay stem |
| `#ttsvol` | TTS (2) | **90** | same | TTS sample level |
| `#mediavol` | (HTML video) | **20** | linear `mediavol/100 * vol/100` | Board TV only |
| Voice `vol` | voice cfg | type table / **0** | `dbtoamp(vol_db)` | `#synth` type select sets [`VOICE_LEVEL_VOLUME_DB`](../../backend/wasm/voicelevelvolume.ts); `#synthN vol` overrides |

CLI: [`zss/firmware/audio.ts`](../../../../firmware/audio.ts) (`#vol`, `#playvol`, `#bgvol`, `#ttsvol`, `#mediavol`).

## Master / bus constants (`zss_config.h`)

Parity-tuned values -- change only with `yarn task run ops:daisy:*:calibrate` or intentional re-tune.

| Constant | Value | Controls |
|----------|-------|----------|
| Main limiter | DaisySP `Limiter` @ 1, then `kMainLimiterMakeup` (~**1.632** / +4.3 dB) | SoftLimit(0.7) ceiling → full scale; safety `clamp +/-1` after |
| `kPlayBusGain` | **1.000** | Retired for live play (SAB dB law); calibrate may rewrite |
| `kDrumBusGain` | **1.000** | Drum stem vs play (target drum−play **−11 ±2** dB; `ops:daisy:play-drum-balance:calibrate`) |
| `kVoiceOutGain` | **0.5** (−6 dB) | Post-FX voice output (flat trim after type-level normalize) |
| `kScMakeupDb` | **+5** | Sidechain makeup (Tone +24 buried kit; cafe ear) |
| `kScMix` | **0.75** | Sidechain wet mix (Tone product) |
| `kScAttackSec` / `kScReleaseSec` | **0.001** / 0.06 | Fast duck onset so hits punch play |
| SC key trims | bg/tts **-12 dB**, drums **`kScDrumKeyDb` (−20)** | Key bus only (`zss_main.cpp`) |
| `kScDrumBassKeyDb` | **+8** | Bass into SC only (Tone MembraneSynth volume); audible kick stays `kDrumBassVolumeDb` |
| SC clap/bass tap | pre-`kDrumGains` | `drumsout()` — kit gain is audible-only |
| `kMainCompThresholdDb` | **-24** | Main compressor (was Tone −28) |
| `kMainCompRatio` | **4** | |
| `kMainCompKneeDb` | **30** | Soft knee (Tone `Compressor` knee) |
| `kMainCompMix` | **1.0** | Full wet GR |
| `kMainCompAttackSec` / `kMainCompReleaseSec` | 0.003 / 0.15 | RMS detector (Tone release 150 ms) |
| `kMainCompGainAttackSec` / `kMainCompGainReleaseSec` | 0.008 / 0.15 | applied GR slew (release matches Tone) |
| `kRazzleVibratoWet` | **0.02** | Post-comp bed |
| `kRazzleChorusWet` | **0.25** | |
| `kRazzleHissGain` | **0.0007** | Tape hiss into the chorus. About -3 dB from the prior 0.001 |

SAB bypass / control slots: COMP_BYPASS (3), SC_BYPASS (4), SC_KEY_MUTE (5), VOL (6), LIM_BYPASS (7) for offline A/B / live listen (`?no_comp=1`, `?no_sc=1`, `?no_sc_key=1`, `?no_lim=1`).

## FX return bus (multi-FX)

Bus law (`zss_fx.cpp` `applyfxgroup`):

```text
out = dry + compress( (Sigma send_i * contribution_i) * kFxReturnWetTrim )
```

| Knob | Value | File | Notes |
|------|-------|------|-------|
| `#fx on` vibrato, autofilter | send preset **50** (~0.89 linear) | `wasmfxstate.ts` | Tone archive match |
| `#fx on` echo, reverb, fc, distort, autowah | send preset **18** (~0.32 linear) | same | Tone archive match |
| `#fx 0-100` | `10^((20*log10(v)-35)/20)` | same | Player send |
| `kFxReturnWetTrim` | **1.4** | `zss_config.h` | After wet sum |
| `kReverbPostGain` | **1.5** | `zss_config.h` | `tanh(wet * gain)` |
| FX return comp | **-24 dB / 4:1 / knee 6** | `zss_config.h` | On wet only |
| Distortion drive | **sin(dry × 3·(1+9·amt)·π)** | `zss_fx.cpp` | Foldback wet after return-comp |
| Echo feedback default | **0.666** (clamp 0-0.95) | `wasmfxstate.ts` | |
| Reverb decay default | **2.5** | same | |

**Multi-FX loudness:** FX are parallel sends on **full dry**. Each enabled send adds wet energy; dry is never attenuated. Stacking echo+reverb+distort raises peak/RMS until return comp and main comp catch it.

## Per-voice / drum trims (`zss_config.h`)

| Constant | Value | Voice / use |
|----------|-------|-------------|
| `kSineVoiceGain` | 2.5 | `sine`, `amsine`, `fmsine` |
| `kSynthNoteOnDuckSec` / `kSynthNoteOnFadeSec` | 0.001 / 0.003 | Duck / fade floors |
| `kSynthNoteOnRampMaxSec` | 0.010 | `sine`, `amsine`, `fmsine` stretch each ramp to half a cycle, capped here |
| `kTriangleVoiceGain` / `kSawtoothVoiceGain` | 1.23 / 1.28 | Triangle / sawtooth (+ am/fm/fat carriers) |
| `kAmVoiceGain` | 2.0 | AM family makeup (not `amsine`) |
| `kFmVoiceGain` | 1.0 | FM (not `fmsine`; carrier amp 1.0 in `fmcarriersample`) |
| `kAlgoOpGain` | ~0.316 (-10 dB) | Algo ops |
| `kAlgoOutGain` | 0.95 | Algo out |
| `kNoiseVoiceGain` | 4.5 | Noise (with `kNoiseBaseExpr` 0.19) |
| `kLfsrVoiceBoost` | 1.6 | Non-soft chip |
| `kNoiseSoftGain` | 1.1 | Hollow / white soft tables |
| `kMetallicAmp` | 4 | Metallic table build |
| clang expression | 0.475 | `noisemetafor` (was 0.4) |
| `kStringMachineGain` / `kStringPluckGain` | 1.35 / 4.2 | String (`tanh(x*gain)` crest limit; accent 0.12; pitch-retrigger) |
| `kKarplusMaxDamping` | 0.85 | Cap for pluck/guitar (DaisySP >= 0.95 = infinite ring); note-off also via voiceenv |
| `kWindFluteGain` / `kWindClarinetGain` / `kWindBrassGain` | 3.11 / 1.79 / 2.5 | Selectable wind (`#synth flute`/`clarinet`/`brass`) |
| `kWindPanpipeGain` | 3.41 | Legacy native ( `#synth panpipe` removed) |
| `kWind*BreathCont` / `kWind*BreathBurst` | flute 0.04/0.42; clarinet 0.02/0.55; brass 0.04/0.60 | Louder short chiff (~45 ms); light sustain air |
| `kPianoVoiceGain` | 3.15 | `#synth piano` |
| `kTimpaniVoiceGain` | 0.70 | Legacy native (`#synth timpani` removed) |
| `kBowedVoiceGain` / `kGuitarVoiceGain` | 1.2 / 4.4 | Violin / steel (`tanh` after gain; pitch-retrigger) |
| `kOrganTonewheelGain` | 1.8 | Tonewheel organ (locked) |
| `kDootVoiceGain` | 1.15 | Doot |
| `kDripVoiceGain` / `kDripDettackSec` | 1.32 / 0.35 | Legacy native (`#synth drip` removed) |
| `kBellsVoiceGain` | 0.35 | Bells mix (cafe ear trim; was 0.49) |
| `kDrumTickTrim` / `kDrumTweetTrim` | **1.0** / **1.0** | Hi-hat extras folded into flat gains |
| `kDrumGains[12]` | **0.05** each | Flat kit (−26 dB into bus before `kDrumBusGain`); stem gate target drum−play **−11 ±2** dB |
| `kDrumCowbellVolumeDb` | **0** | Was +8; cowbell matches flat gains |
| `kDrumBassVolumeDb` | **0** | Kick uses `kDrumGains[9]` only |

Native `k*VoiceGain` values above are waveform makeup inside DSP. **Effective loudness vs `#synth square`** is normalized on type select via per-type `volume` dB in [`voicelevelvolume.ts`](../../backend/wasm/voicelevelvolume.ts) (`withlevelvolume` in `wasmvoiceconfig.ts`), written to voicecfg slot 5. Offline gate: mid-window RMS within **±1.5 dB** of square (comp/SC/limiter bypassed; `ops/lib/daisy-parity/voicelevelsweep.ts`). Base default remains **0** (`DEFAULT_WASM_VOICE_VOLUME_DB`) until a `#synth` type is selected.

## Web Audio shell

| Stage | Gain | File |
|-------|------|------|
| Worklet -> destination | unity | `daisyengine.ts` |
| Broadcast tap | `GainNode = 1` | same |
| TTS into worklet | `GainNode = 1` | level in WASM `readttsvolume` |

## What to tweak when

| Symptom | First knobs | Calibrate task |
|---------|-------------|----------------|
| Too loud at boot | `WASM_DEFAULT_PLAY_VOLUME`, `#vol` | -- |
| Multi-FX pile-up | `#fx on` presets, `kFxReturnWetTrim` | `ops:daisy:level-stability:test:fxmatrix` |
| Play vs drums balance | `kDrumBusGain`, `#playvol` | `ops:daisy:play-drum-balance:calibrate` |
| Idle play too hot / drums buried | `kScMakeupDb`, `kScMix` | `zss_config.h` |
| Player quick trim | `#vol`, `#playvol`, `#bgvol`, `#ttsvol`, `#mediavol`, `#fx N` | -- |

## Legacy / not live Daisy

[`wasmlevels.ts`](../../backend/wasm/wasmlevels.ts) exports Tone-parity constants (`WASM_PLAY_BUS_GAIN`, `WASM_DRUM_BUS_GAIN`, etc.) for archived Maxi/Tone math -- **not** the live Daisy bus gains in `zss_config.h`.

---

# Matrix
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/implementation-matrix

How the DaisySP synth implements voices, FX, drums, and the main chain.

Related: [audiochain.md](audiochain.md), [drums.md](drums.md), [parallel-fx-bus.md](parallel-fx-bus.md), [CUTOVER.md](../../backend/daisy/CUTOVER.md). Player-facing param teaching: [voices](/synth/voices), [effects](/synth/effects).

## Runtime

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  synthCmd["#synth / #play / FX cmds"]
  sab["SharedArrayBuffer control"]
  daisy["DaisySP WASM"]
  synthCmd --> sab --> daisy
```

Playback boots through [`createsynthbackend`](../../backend/synthbackendfactory.ts), which only starts Daisy. DSP is C++ under [`native/zss/`](../../backend/daisy/native/zss/) with the WASM API in [`zss_daisy_synth.cpp`](../../backend/daisy/native/zss_daisy_synth.cpp) and the worklet in [`daisyengine.ts`](../../backend/daisy/daisyengine.ts). Shared SAB helpers live in [`backend/wasm/`](../../backend/wasm/).

**DaisySP modules in use:** `Oscillator`, `Adsr` (doot/sparkle/algo operators only), `Decimator`, `Overdrive`, `Svf`, `Phasor`, `DelayLine`, `Chorus`, `WhiteNoise`, `DcBlock`, `OnePole`, `Autowah`, `StringVoice` (`#synth pluck` strike), `ModalVoice` (bells), and `SyntheticBassDrum` (tom). Bass is a custom membrane. **`#synth env`** on play voices uses **`ZssLinearEnv`** (linear ADSR, note-on reset), not DaisySP `Adsr`. Envelope checks are `yarn task run ops:daisy:adsr-parity:test` (Jest `adsrenvcurve`). **`#synth string`** uses the SOS ensemble (saws + `Svf`/`OnePole`). **Voice FX** are parallel sends in `applyfxgroup()` ([parallel-fx-bus.md](parallel-fx-bus.md)). **Main compressor** is a Tone-shaped knee in `maincompressor()`. **Sidechain duck** is a custom power-domain envelope on the play bus. **`#reverb`** uses DaisySP-LGPL **ReverbSc** plus predelay and `tanh(wet × kReverbPostGain)`.

---

## Table 1 — Voice types (`SOURCE_TYPE`)

Enum: [`shared/sourcetype.ts`](../../shared/sourcetype.ts). Dispatch: `VoiceType` in [`zss_daisy_synth.cpp`](../../backend/daisy/native/zss_daisy_synth.cpp).

| ZSS name | Enum | DaisySP | Closest [DaisySP feature](https://github.com/electro-smith/DaisySP#-features) | Key files |
|----------|------|---------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| `sine`/`square`/…/`fat*` | `SYNTH` | `ZssLinearEnv` + `Oscillator` | Subtractive / FM | cpp `synthsource()` |
| `retro` | `RETRO_NOISE` | Custom LFSR tables + ADSR | Noise (custom) | `noisewave.ts` |
| `buzz` | `BUZZ_NOISE` | same, different LFSR tap | Noise | `noisemeta.ts` |
| `clang` | `CLANG_NOISE` | same | Noise | same |
| `metallic` | `METALLIC_NOISE` | same + amplitude norm | Noise | same |
| `hollow` | `HOLLOW_NOISE` | FFT hollow table | Noise (custom spectral) | `noisewave.ts` |
| `noise` | `WHITE_NOISE` | PRNG white table | Whitenoise (custom PRNG) | `noisewave.ts` |
| `bells` | `BELLS` | `ModalVoice` + sparkle + `voiceenv` | Physical modeling + FM sparkle | cpp `processvoice()` |
| `doot` | `DOOT` | `Oscillator` + `Adsr` | Drum / physical | cpp `dootvoice()` |
| `algo0`–`algo7` | `ALGO_SYNTH` | 4× `Oscillator` + 5× `Adsr` | FM (4-op routing) | [Algo FM](/synth/algosynth) |
| `string` | `STRING_VOICE` (algo 0) | SOS ensemble (`stringmachinevoice`) | Subtractive string-machine | cpp `stringmachinevoice()` |
| `pluck` | `STRING_VOICE` (algo 1) | `StringVoice` × `voiceenv` | Physical modeling | cpp `processvoice()` |
| `flute` / `clarinet` / `brass` | `WIND_VOICE` | `windvoice()` formant bank + breath burst | Subtractive + formants | cpp `zss_sosvoices.cpp` |
| `piano` | `PIANO_VOICE` | `pianovoice()` | FM / hammer model | cpp `zss_sosvoices.cpp` |
| `violin` | `BOWED_VOICE` | `bowedvoice()` delayed vibrato | Subtractive bowed | cpp `zss_sosvoices.cpp` |
| `steel` | `GUITAR_VOICE` | `guitarvoice()` + `StringVoice` | Physical modeling | cpp `zss_sosvoices.cpp` |
| `tonewheel` | `ORGAN_VOICE` | `organvoice()` scanner vibrato + drawbars | Additive drawbars | cpp `zss_sosvoices.cpp` |

**Removed named types** (not selectable): `drip`, `panpipe`, `epiano`, `timpani`, `viola`, `nylon`, and `drawbar` as a voice (`drawbar` remains a `#synth tonewheel` param). Allowlist: [`voiceconfig/validation.ts`](../../voiceconfig/validation.ts).

**SYNTH sub-modes** ([`wasmosctype.ts`](../../backend/wasm/wasmosctype.ts)): basic waves, pulse/PWM, AM, FM, fat.

---

## Table 2 — Voice FX

Parallel wet sends. Vibrato is pitch modulation, not a wet send. See [parallel-fx-bus.md](parallel-fx-bus.md) and [effects](/synth/effects).

| ZSS FX | Aliases | DaisySP | Key files |
|--------|---------|---------|-----------|
| `fc` | `fcrush` | `Decimator` | cpp `applyfxgroup()` |
| `echo` | — | `DelayLine` | cpp |
| `reverb` | — | **ReverbSc** + predelay (LGPL) | cpp |
| `autofilter` | — | `Svf` + `Phasor` | cpp |
| `vibrato` | — | Pitch cents + `fxvibratolfo` | cpp |
| `distortion` | `distort` | `Overdrive` | cpp |
| `autowah` | — | `Autowah` | cpp |

**Bus layout:** 4 groups via [`voicefxgroup.ts`](../../voicefxgroup.ts). SAB: [`wasmfxstate.ts`](../../backend/wasm/wasmfxstate.ts).

---

## Table 3 — Main chain

| Processor | Role | DaisySP | Key files |
|-----------|------|---------|-----------|
| Sidechain duck | Duck `#play` when bg/TTS/drums hit | Custom envelope + TTS key | cpp |
| Main compressor | Bus dynamics | Custom knee compressor | cpp `maincompressor()` |
| Razzle | Master character | Manual vibrato delay + `Chorus` + hiss | cpp |
| Output safety | Peak control | `Limiter` | cpp `zss_process()` |
| DC block | Master out | `DcBlock` | cpp `zss_process()` |
| Master trim | Level staging | **-10 dB trim**, 0 makeup (no comp); play **Tone volumetodb(20)**; drum **play × 1.35** | [`zss_daisy_synth.cpp`](../../backend/daisy/native/zss_daisy_synth.cpp) |

**Main compressor params:** threshold −28 dB, ratio 4:1, attack 3 ms, release 150 ms, knee 30 dB, applied GR slew 8 ms / 150 ms (Tone product).

**Sidechain params:** threshold −42 dB (power domain), ratio 5:1, attack 5 ms, release 60 ms, mix 0.75, makeup **+24 dB** (Tone product); bg/TTS send −12 dB, drum send **−28 dB** (`kScDrumKeyDb`).

**FX bus gain:** per-send linear gain from [`wasmfxstate.ts`](../../backend/wasm/wasmfxstate.ts) (`on` → 50). Echo/reverb use send×wet; **`wet_sum`** × 1.4 then the return compressor before `dry + wet_sum`. Offline matrix: `yarn task run ops:daisy:level-stability:test:fxmatrix`.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  play["play bus + voice FX"]
  duck["sidechain gain"]
  mix["+ bgplay + TTS + drums"]
  razz["razzle"]
  lim["clamp + dcblock"]
  out["master vol → output"]
  play --> duck --> mix --> razz --> lim --> out
  bg["bgplay"] --> scTrigger["sidechain trigger"]
  tts["TTS"] --> scTrigger
  drums["drums clap+bass tap"] --> scTrigger
  scTrigger --> duck
  bg --> mix
  tts --> mix
  drums --> mix
```

| ID | Drum | DaisySP | Key files |
|----|------|---------|-----------|
| 0 | Tick | Custom noise + EQ | cpp `drumtick()` |
| 1 | Tweet | Custom noise + EQ | cpp `drumtweet()` |
| 2 | Cowbell | Custom dual square + bandpass | `drumcowbell()` |
| 3 | Clap | `WhiteNoise` + EQ | `drumclap()`; sidechain tap |
| 4 | Hi snare | Custom | cpp |
| 5 | Hi woodblock | Custom | `drumwoodblock(true)` |
| 6 | Low snare | Custom | cpp |
| 7 | Low tom | `SyntheticBassDrum` | cpp |
| 8 | Low woodblock | Custom | `drumwoodblock(false)` |
| 9 | Bass | Custom sine + expo pitch | `drumbass()`; sidechain tap |
| 10 | Crash | Custom modal cymbal | cpp `zss_drums.cpp` |
| 11 | Ride | Custom modal cymbal + ping | cpp `zss_drums.cpp` |

# FX bus
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/parallel-fx-bus

DSP spec for per-group voice FX routing in `zss_daisy_synth.cpp`.

## Routing

- **4 FX groups** (play 0–1, play 2–3, bgplay, TTS) — see [voicefxgroup.ts](../../voicefxgroup.ts).
- Each effect is a **parallel send** from the same dry sample per block.
- **Vibrato** is not in the wet sum; it modulates pitch on play voices before the FX tap.

## Bus law (Tone-like wet return)

```
wet_sum = Σᵢ sendᵢ · contributionᵢ(dry)

contribution = wetᵢ(dry)              echo, reverb (full effect return)
contribution = wetᵢ(dry) − dry        fcrush, distortion
contribution = fxautofilterbus(dry)   (band − dry)
contribution = fxautowahbus(dry)      (wah delta)

wet_sum × kFxReturnWetTrim → fxreturncompress(wet_sum, group)

out = dry + wet_sum
```

- **Dry is always full level** on the main path.
- **Echo/reverb** use **send × wet** (not send × (wet − dry)) so delay tails and room energy are audible; the old delta law made steady-state echo ~inaudible.
- **No order** between FX types (echo does not see reverb).
- Per-group processor state (`ZssFxGroup`) — `#echo1`…`#echo4` stay independent.

## Send levels

| Source | Range |
|--------|--------|
| `#fx off` | 0 |
| `#fx on` | Preset via `volumetodb` — **50** for vibrato/autofilter (~−1 dB); **18** for echo/reverb/fc/distort/autowah (~−10 dB) |
| `#fx 0–100` | `volumetodb(v) = 20·log10(v) − 35` → linear send in SAB |

## Return-bus compressor

Applied to **`wet_sum` only** (dry punch preserved).

| Constant | Value |
|----------|--------|
| Wet trim | **1.4** linear bus gain before compressor |
| Threshold | −24 dBFS (envelope) |
| Ratio | 4:1 |
| Knee | 6 dB |
| Attack | 2 ms |
| Release | 80 ms |

Per-group envelope follower in `ZssFxGroup::return_comp_env`. Detector still runs when `wet_sum` is zero so the envelope can decay between hits.

## Per-algorithm trims (unchanged)

- Reverb: DaisySP-LGPL **ReverbSc** + predelay; `tanh(wet × kReverbPostGain)` (**1.5**)
- Echo: feedback clamp 0–0.95
- Distortion: `sin(dry × 3·(1+9·amt)·π)` foldback added after return-comp (not into the shared wet compressor)

## Main bus (out of scope)

Sidechain duck → master compressor → razzle → volume — unchanged downstream of `applyfxgroup`.

## Regression

`yarn level-stability:test --filter fxmatrix`:

- Peak vs `fxmatrix-dry` (≤6 dB), peak ≤ −0.5 dBFS
- Solo FX audibility: peak within 4 dB of dry (distortion ≥ +4 dB hotter); diagnostic wet-lift report in [`fxbusmetrics.ts`](../../backend/daisy/fxbusmetrics.ts)

`yarn fx-bus-metrics:test` — offline wet-lift decomposition report (no Playwright).

---

# Notation
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/playnotation

`#play` and `#bgplay` take a short string of durations, notes, and drum hits.

## The digit trap

Digits `0`–`9` (and `p` / `k` / `r`) are **drum triggers**, not tempo or octave numbers.

| Wrong idea | What actually plays |
|------------|---------------------|
| `#play 50 c` as “C at 50” | Hi woodblock + hat + note C |
| Pitch literal `C4` in a play string | Digit `4` is hi snare — do not embed Tone-style pitches |

Prefer duration + note letters: `#play qc`, `hc`, `qceg`.

## Character map

| Character | Operation |
|-----------|------------|
| a-g, A-G | Notes A through G |
| x, X | Rest |
| # | Sharp |
| ! | Flat |
| + | Octave up |
| - | Octave down |
| y, Y | 64th note |
| t, T | 32nd note |
| s, S | 16th note |
| i, I | 8th note |
| q, Q | Quarter note |
| h, H | Half note |
| w, W | Whole note |
| 3 | Triplet |
| . | Dotted (1.5x) |
| 0 | Drum tick (hi-hat) |
| 1 | Drum tweet (open hi-hat) |
| 2 | Cowbell |
| p | Clap |
| 4 | Hi snare |
| 5 | Hi woodblock |
| 6 | Low snare |
| 7 | Low tom |
| 8 | Low woodblock |
| 9 | Bass drum |
| k | Crash cymbal |
| r | Ride cymbal |

## Write a bar

Duration sticks until you change it. Notes after a duration use that length.

```text
#synth square
#play qcde
```

Quarter notes C–D–E at the default octave.

```text
#play hc x qc
```

Half-note C, rest, quarter C.

```text
#play qceg;ixix
```

Voice 0: quarter C–E–G. Voice 1 (after `;`): eighth rests and notes. More voices: more `;` parts. Voices past the fourth `#play` slot bleed onto `#bgplay` (see below).

```text
#play q9 q4 qc
```

Bass drum, snare, then a pitched C — useful with [drums](/synth/drums).

## Multi-voice and bgplay

- Separate voices with `;`
- Fifth semicolon part lands on `#bgplay` channel 4 (keeps bgplay patch / volume / FX)
- A ninth voice is dropped

Full scale cheat sheets: [scales](/synth/scales). Voice and FX teaching: [voices](/synth/voices), [effects](/synth/effects).

## Duration math (quick)

Base unit is a 64th. Triplet divides by 3; dotted multiplies by 1.5.

| Token | Relative length |
|-------|-----------------|
| y | 1 |
| t | 2 |
| s | 4 |
| i | 8 |
| q | 16 |
| h | 32 |
| w | 64 |

Live `#play` / `#bgplay` add a tiny onset humanize (±4 ms / ±2 ms). Offline `#synthrecord` stays grid-locked. Portamento notes skip jitter so glides stay locked.

---

# Recording
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/record-and-mp3

## Active path — Daisy (`backend/daisy/daisyrecordhandler.ts` + `daisyofflinerender.ts`)

`#synthrecord` on the Daisy backend:

1. Captures tick events during live playback (`RECORDING_STATE` in `shared/recording.ts`)
2. Snapshots voice/FX state via `wasmreplaystate.ts`
3. Boots an isolated Daisy engine on `OfflineAudioContext`
4. Replays ticks with offline render hooks for sample-accurate SAB updates
5. Renders via `startRendering()` (faster than real time). Offline and live engines each own SAB channel buffers (`sabpush` / `sabseq` are scoped per `SabEngine`), so render pushes do not drive the live worklet. Tape logs `rendering audio N%` every 5% via the offline tick hook
6. Applies **-3 dB** export headroom (`RECORD_EXPORT_TRIM_DB` / `trimaudiobufferdb`) before lamejs
7. Converts rendered `AudioBuffer` to MP3 via `converttomp3()`
8. Triggers download

If `OfflineAudioContext` or offline worklet boot fails, `#synthrecord` surfaces an error (no real-time fallback).

---

## mp3.ts

### converttomp3(buffer: AudioBuffer)

Converts a Web Audio `AudioBuffer` to MP3 using lamejs.

**Process:**
1. Read stereo PCM from channels 0/1 (mono duplicates channel 0)
2. Create Mp3Encoder(2, sampleRate, 128) — stereo, 128 kbps
3. Process in 1152-sample blocks (lamejs requirement)
4. Convert float32 → int16 (scale to ±32767)
5. Encode each block
6. Flush encoder
7. Concatenate all chunks to Uint8Array

**Dependency:** `@breezystack/lamejs`

---

# Sources
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/source

Factory for creating sound sources (`source.ts`). Defines available synth types and their implementations.

## SOURCE_TYPE Enum

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `SYNTH` | Basic Tone.js Synth (oscillator + envelope) |
| `RETRO_NOISE` | Procedural retro-style noise |
| `BUZZ_NOISE` | Procedural buzz noise |
| `CLANG_NOISE` | Procedural clang noise |
| `METALLIC_NOISE` | Procedural metallic noise |
| `BELLS` | FMSynth + MetalSynth sparkle |
| `DOOT` | MembraneSynth (drum-like) |
| `ALGO_SYNTH` | Custom 4-operator FM synth |
| `HOLLOW_NOISE` | BeepBox hollow chip noise (WASM only) |
| `WHITE_NOISE` | BeepBox white chip noise — `#synth noise` (WASM only) |

## BeepBox chip noise mapping (WASM)

WASM noise voices use [BeepBox](https://github.com/johnnesky/beepbox) `chipNoises` wave tables (32768 samples) and `noiseSynth` playback (pitch-relative smoothing + expression gain). Tone path still uses the legacy 131072-sample Sampler tables until a follow-up.

| `#synth` | BeepBox index | Generation |
|----------|---------------|------------|
| `retro` | 0 | LFSR `1<<14` |
| `noise` | 1 | Fixed-seed PRNG (BeepBox white) |
| `clang` | 2 | LFSR `2<<14` |
| `buzz` | 3 | LFSR `10<<2` |
| `hollow` | 4 | FFT-designed hollow spectrum |
| `metallic` | *(none — ZSS legacy)* | LFSR `15<<2`, fixed `(bit)*4*7.5-8` amplitude |

`#synth noise` and `#synth hollow` are WASM-only voice types (BeepBox chip noise).

## Noise Generation (Tone path — legacy)

Tone noise sources still use a deterministic LFSR-style algorithm:

- **Buffer size:** 131072 samples
- **Feedback taps** vary by type:
  - `RETRO_NOISE`: 1<<14
  - `CLANG_NOISE`: 2<<14
  - `BUZZ_NOISE`: 10<<2
  - `METALLIC_NOISE`: 15<<2 (with random amplitude variation)

METALLIC_NOISE uses additional amplitude scaling for a brighter character.

## Source-Specific Processing

- **Noise sources:** Chain through `filter1` (lowshelf -32dB) and `filter2` (highshelf +32dB) before output
- **BELLS:** Triggers both `synth` and `sparkle` (MetalSynth) for harmonic content
- **ALGO_SYNTH:** Stores `algo` index for algorithm selection

## API

```typescript
const { source, applyreset, getreplay, setreplay, destroy } = createsource(SOURCE_TYPE.SYNTH, 0)
```

Each source returns an object with:
- `source` — The Tone.js node(s)
- `applyreset()` — Restore default parameters
- `getreplay()` — Capture current state for recording
- `setreplay(replay)` — Restore state during replay
- `destroy()` — Dispose nodes

---

# Source wiring
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/sourcefxsetup

Wires 8 sound sources and 4 FX channel groups into the audio chain (`sourcefxsetup.ts`).

## Layout

- **8 sources** — Indices 0-7, all start as SYNTH
- **4 FX groups** — Indices 0-3
- **Source→FX mapping:** `mapindextofx(index)`:
  - 0,1 → FX 0
  - 2,3 → FX 1
  - 4,5,6,7 → FX 2

## Routing Rules

| Source Type | Connection |
|-------------|------------|
| SYNTH, BELLS, DOOT, ALGO_SYNTH | synth → sendtofx |
| BELLS | Also: sparkle → sendtofx |
| RETRO/BUZZ/CLANG/METALLIC_NOISE | synth → filter1 → filter2 → sendtofx |

Noise sources use a filter chain (lowshelf + highshelf) before the FX send.

## changesource(index, type, algo)

Replaces the source at `index`:
1. Disposes current source
2. Creates new source via `createsource(type, algo)`
3. Reconnects via `connectsource(index)`

No-op if type and algo are unchanged.

## Play vs Background

- FX 0, 1 → `playvolume` (main playback)
- FX 2, 3 → `bgplayvolume` (background SFX)

Background sources (4-7) use FX 2; `SYNTH_SFX_RESET` (4) is where bgplay index wraps.

---

# Note ticks
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/tickhandler

Handles scheduled note events (`tickhandler.ts`). Called by the Tone.js Part (pacer) for each scheduled tick.

## createtickhandler(sourceFx, chain, recording, playback)

Returns `synthtick(time, value)` callback.

## value: SYNTH_NOTE_ON

`[chan, duration, note]`

- `chan`: Source/FX channel index (0-7)
- `duration`: Tone.js notation (e.g. "8n", "4n")
- `note`: `string` (pitch), `number` (drum id), or `null` (rest)

## String Notes (Pitch)

1. **BELLS:** Triggers sparkle at +2 octaves, random detune ±3 cents
2. **All:** `synth.triggerAttackRelease(note, duration, time)`
3. **Vibrato ramp:** depth 0→1 over 2n, 1→0 before release; frequency 1→5→1

## Numeric Notes (Drums)

| note | Drum | Trigger |
|------|------|---------|
| 0 | Tick | hi-hat closed |
| 1 | Tweet | hi-hat open |
| 2 | Cowbell | cowbell |
| 3 | Clap | clap |
| 4 | Hi snare | hi snare |
| 5 | Hi woodblock | hi woodblock |
| 6 | Low snare | low snare |
| 7 | Low tom | low tom |
| 8 | Low woodblock | low woodblock |
| 9 | Bass | kick |
| -1 | End | Decrements pacercount, clears pacer when 0 |

## Recording

- **Normal:** Pushes `[time, value]` to `recordedticks`
- **Replay (recordisrendering > 0):** Updates `recordlastpercent`, writes to register for progress display

---

# Synth
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/voices

This page is for writing music in cafe.

## Before you play

| Command | What it does |
|---------|--------------|
| `#synth <name>` | Select / configure all four `#play` voices |
| `#synth1` … `#synth4` | One play voice |
| `#synth5 …` | `#bgplay` voices |
| `#synth restart` | Clear sticky config and FX SAB when A/B gets muddy |

:::tip Digits in `#play` are drums
`#play 50 c` is woodblock + hat + C — not “C at tempo 50”. Prefer `#play qc`, `hc`, or `qceg`. See [notation](/synth/playnotation).
:::

**Expect language below** means: paste the recipe, listen once, change one knob, listen again.

## Shared knobs (all voices)

| Key | Meaning |
|-----|---------|
| `vol` | Level in dB. Type select already applies a per-voice normalize; `#synth vol` overrides. |
| `env <a> <d> <s> <r>` | Attack / decay / sustain / release (seconds; sustain 0–1) |
| `port <seconds>` | Portamento (glide). Works on oscillator, algo, and violin. |

Configs can survive a type switch until `#synth restart`.

```text
#synth square
#synth env 0.01 0.1 0.4 0.2
#play qceg
```

**Expect:** short square arpeggio with a little sustain.

---

## Basic waves

Clean single oscillators: `sine`, `square`, `triangle`, `sawtooth`, `custom` (`custom` maps to square in Daisy).

| Key | Ear meaning |
|-----|-------------|
| `phase <degrees>` | Start phase (180 = half cycle). Used by basic and fat waves. |

```text
#synth sine
#play hc
#synth square
#play hc
```

**Expect:** soft round tone → bright hollow square, same pitch and length.

---

## Pulse and PWM

| Voice | Intent |
|-------|--------|
| `pulse` | Fixed pulse shape |
| `pwm` | Pulse width moves with an LFO |

| Key | Range | Ear meaning |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| `width` | −1…1 (default ~0.2) | Pulse shape — thinner vs fatter |
| `modfreq` | Hz (default 1) | **PWM LFO rate**, not FM. Faster = buzzier warble |

```text
#synth pulse
#synth width 0.1
#play qc
#synth pwm
#synth modfreq 4
#synth width 0.4
#play hc
```

**Expect:** static thin pulse → slow-then-faster width wiggle on a held note.

---

## AM and FM

AM rings the carrier with a modulator. FM bends pitch with a modulator (`#synth fm*` ≈ Tone FMOscillator, not FMSynth).

| Key | AM | FM | Defaults |
|-----|----|----|----------|
| `harmonicity` | yes | yes | `1` (mod Hz = note × ratio; `2` = octave) |
| `modtype` | yes | yes | `square` (`sine` / `triangle` / `sawtooth` also) |
| `modenv` | yes | yes | ADSR on modulation depth |
| `modindex` | no | **yes** | `2` — depth. Law: `f ≈ fc * (1 + I * m)` |

```text
#synth fmsine
#synth harmonicity 1
#synth modindex 2
#play qc
#synth modindex 8
#play qc
```

**Expect:** mild metallic FM → much more clangy / sideband-heavy.

```text
#synth amsquare
#synth harmonicity 2
#play hc
```

**Expect:** amplitude wobble at twice the note rate (octave-related AM).

---

## Fat (unison)

Several detuned copies of one wave: `fatsine`, `fatsquare`, `fattriangle`, `fatsawtooth`.

| Key | Default | Ear meaning |
|-----|---------|-------------|
| `count` | 3 | How many oscillators |
| `spread` | 20 | Cents between them (not piano unison) |
| `phase` | 0 | Same as basic waves |

```text
#synth fatsawtooth
#synth count 3
#synth spread 20
#play hc
#synth spread 80
#play hc
```

**Expect:** mild chorus → wide detuned stack.

---

## Noise, chips, bells, doot

| Voice | Intent |
|-------|--------|
| `retro` / `buzz` / `clang` / `metallic` | Chip / LFSR noise flavors |
| `noise` / `hollow` | White / hollow spectral noise (Daisy) |
| `bells` | Modal one-shot chime |
| `doot` | Short pitched blip |

Mostly `env` and `vol` — no oscillator knobs.

```text
#synth bells
#play qc
#synth metallic
#play qceg
```

**Expect:** decaying bell hit → scratchy metallic run.

---

## Algo FM (`algo0`–`algo7`)

Four-operator FM routings. Select with `#synth algoN`, then set keys with `#synth …` (not `#algo0 …`).

| Key | Meaning |
|-----|---------|
| `harmonicity1`…`3` | Operator frequency ratios |
| `modindex1`…`3` | Operator modulation depths |
| `osc1`…`osc4` | Wave: basic / pulse / pwm only |
| `env1`…`env4` | Per-op envelopes |
| `env` / `port` / `vol` | Outer voice envelope, glide, level |

Routing pictures: [algosynth](/synth/algosynth).

```text
#synth algo0
#play qceg
#synth algo5
#play qceg
```

**Expect:** different FM timbres on the same notes (algo5 is usually thinner / brighter than algo0).

```text
#synth algo0
#synth osc1 sine
#synth harmonicity1 2
#synth modindex1 3
#play hc
```

**Expect:** clearer sine carrier with stronger mod from op 1.

---

## Instruments (SOS)

These voices follow Gordon Reid’s [Synth Secrets](https://www.soundonsound.com/series/synth-secrets-sound-sound) instrument articles (Sound On Sound) — subtractive / heuristic models, not sample libraries. Shared `env` / `vol` / `port` (where wired) still apply. Exclusive knobs are 0–1 unless noted.

### String machine — `string`

Based on: [Synthesizing Strings: String Machines](https://www.soundonsound.com/techniques/synthesizing-strings-string-machines), [PWM & String Sounds](https://www.soundonsound.com/techniques/synthesizing-strings-pwm-string-sounds).

| Key | Default-ish | Ear |
|-----|-------------|-----|
| `detune` | 0.25 | Ensemble width |
| `pwm` | 0.2 | OSC2 PWM amount |
| `vib` | 0.35 | Vibrato |
| `filter` | 0.5 | Body brightness |

```text
#synth string
#play hcde
#synth filter 0.9
#play hcde
```

**Expect:** pad-like saw stack → brighter / thinner body.

### Pluck — `pluck`

Based on: [Synthesizing Plucked Strings](https://www.soundonsound.com/techniques/synthesizing-plucked-strings) (DaisySP `StringVoice` / Karplus-Strong family).

`structure`, `brightness`, `damping`, `accent` — strike and decay of a string model.

```text
#synth pluck
#play qc egc
#synth damping 0.3
#play qc egc
```

**Expect:** short plucked notes → longer ring when damping drops.

### Wind — `flute`, `clarinet`, `brass`

Same keys: `breath`, `pressure`, `brightness`, `resonance`.

| Voice | Synth Secrets |
|-------|---------------|
| `flute` | [Synthesizing Simple Flutes](https://www.soundonsound.com/techniques/synthesizing-simple-flutes), [Practical Flute Synthesis](https://www.soundonsound.com/techniques/practical-flute-synthesis) |
| `clarinet` | [Synthesizing Wind Instruments](https://www.soundonsound.com/techniques/synthesizing-wind-instruments) (reed / odd-harmonic square) |
| `brass` | [Synthesizing Brass Instruments](https://www.soundonsound.com/techniques/synthesizing-brass-instruments) |

```text
#synth flute
#play qceg
#synth brass
#play qceg
```

**Expect:** airy flute → brassier / louder formants on the same line.

### Piano — `piano`

Based on: [Synthesizing Pianos](https://www.soundonsound.com/techniques/synthesizing-pianos).

`spread` (0–1 unison), `hammer`, `brightness`, `damping`.

```text
#synth piano
#play qc eg
#synth hammer 0.9
#play qc eg
```

**Expect:** soft hammer → harder attack.

### Violin — `violin`

Based on: [Synthesizing Bowed Strings: The Violin Family](https://www.soundonsound.com/techniques/synthesizing-bowed-strings-violin-family), [Practical Bowed-string Synthesis](https://www.soundonsound.com/techniques/practical-bowed-string-synthesis).

`bow`, `pressure`, `vib`, `body`, plus `port` for slides.

```text
#synth violin
#synth port 0.15
#play hcde
```

**Expect:** bowed tone with audible glide between notes.

### Steel guitar — `steel`

Based on: [The Theoretical Acoustic Guitar Patch](https://www.soundonsound.com/techniques/theoretical-acoustic-guitar-patch), [A Final Attempt To Synthesize Guitars](https://www.soundonsound.com/techniques/final-attempt-synthesize-guitars).

`pick`, `body`, `damping`, `position`.

```text
#synth steel
#play qceg
#synth pick 0.8
#play qceg
```

**Expect:** brighter / snappier pick attack.

### Tonewheel organ — `tonewheel`

Based on: [Synthesizing Tonewheel Organs: Part 1](https://www.soundonsound.com/techniques/synthesizing-tonewheel-organs-part-1), [Part 2](https://www.soundonsound.com/techniques/synthesizing-tonewheel-organs-part-2), [Tonewheel Organ Implementations Compared](https://www.soundonsound.com/techniques/tonewheel-organ-implementations-compared).

| Key | Note |
|-----|------|
| `drawbar` | Organ mix param — **not** a voice type |
| `click` / `leak` / `bright` | Key click, crosstalk, brightness |

```text
#synth tonewheel
#play qceg
#synth drawbar 0.9
#synth bright 0.8
#play qceg
```

**Expect:** fuller drawbar stack and brighter top.

---

## Next

- [Effects](/synth/effects) — echo, reverb, distort, vibrato, …
- [Notation](/synth/playnotation) — `#play` characters
- [Scales](/synth/scales) — copy-paste scale lines

# Worklets
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/worklets

Custom AudioWorklet processors for effects not available in Tone.js.

## Frequency Crusher

### fcrushworklet.js

Sample-and-hold style bit crusher. Reduces effective sample rate for lo-fi character.

**Parameters:**
- `rate` (1-512): Samples held per output sample. Lower = more crushed.

**Algorithm:**
```javascript
if (count % rate === 0) sah[channel] = input[channel][i]
output[channel][i] = sah[channel]
count++
```

**Credits:** Timo Hoogland, (c) 2023

### fcrushworkletnode.ts

Tone.js `Effect` wrapper. Exposes `rate` as Param. Must call `addfcrushmodule()` before creating FrequencyCrusher instances.

---

## Sidechain Compressor

### sidechainworklet.js

Ducks main input based on sidechain signal level.

**Parameters:**
- `threshold` (-128 to 0 dB)
- `ratio` (1-128)
- `attack`, `release` (seconds)
- `mix` (0-1): Dry/wet
- `makeupGain` (-128 to 60 dB)

**Inputs:**
- Input 0: Main signal (stereo)
- Input 1: Sidechain (stereo, summed to mono for detection)

**Algorithm:** Level detection on sidechain → gain reduction applied to main → mix with dry.

**Credits:** Based on [jadujoel/sidechain-compressor-audio-worklet](https://github.com/jadujoel/sidechain-compressor-audio-worklet)

### sidechainworkletnode.ts

Tone.js `Effect` wrapper. `sidechain` property is a Gain node—connect sidechain sources to it. Must call `addsidechainmodule()` before creating SidechainCompressor instances.

---

# category.ts
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/words/category

**Purpose**: Parses category values (isterrain, isobject) from word arrays. Maps string names to STR_CATEGORY_CONST. Used when commands need to filter by element category.

## Dependencies

- `zss/mapping/types` — MAYBE, isarray, ispresent, isstring
- `./expr` — readexpr
- `./reader` — READ_CONTEXT
- `./types` — CATEGORY, NAME, WORD

## Exports

| Export | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `categoryconsts` | `{ isterrain: 'ISTERRAIN', isobject: 'ISOBJECT' }` |
| `isstrcategory` | Type guard for STR_CATEGORY |
| `mapstrcategory` | Maps string to STR_CATEGORY_CONST or undefined |
| `readcategory(index)` | Returns `[STR_CATEGORY | undefined, nextIndex]` |

## Types

| Type | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `STR_CATEGORY` | Array of STR_CATEGORY_CONST |
| `STR_CATEGORY_CONST` | `'ISTERRAIN' \| 'ISOBJECT'` |

## readcategory Logic

1. If word at index is already STR_CATEGORY or STR_CATEGORY_CONST → return it
2. If word maps via mapstrcategory → return `[const]`
3. Otherwise try readexpr (e.g. `any isterrain`) and check result
4. Return `[undefined, index]` on failure

---

# collision.ts
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/words/collision

**Purpose**: Parses collision values (iswalk, issolid, isswim, isbullet, isghost) from word arrays. Maps string names to STR_COLLISION_CONST and COLLISION enum. Used when commands check or set collision flags.

## Dependencies

- `zss/mapping/types` — MAYBE, isarray, ispresent, isstring
- `./expr` — readexpr
- `./reader` — READ_CONTEXT
- `./types` — COLLISION, NAME, WORD

## Exports

| Export | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `collisionconsts` | String → STR_COLLISION_CONST mapping |
| `collisionenums` | String → COLLISION enum mapping |
| `isstrcollision` | Type guard for STR_COLLISION |
| `mapstrcollision` | Maps string to STR_COLLISION_CONST or undefined |
| `mapstrcollisiontoenum` | STR_COLLISION → COLLISION |
| `readcollision(index)` | Returns `[STR_COLLISION | undefined, nextIndex]` |

## Aliases

| Alias | Maps To |
|-------|---------|
| iswalking, iswalkable | ISWALK |
| isswimming, isswimmable | ISSWIM |

## readcollision Logic

1. If word is already STR_COLLISION or STR_COLLISION_CONST → return it
2. Otherwise try readexpr and check result
3. Return `[undefined, index]` on failure

---

# color.ts
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/words/color

**Purpose**: Parses and maps color values from word arrays. Supports foreground, background (on*), numeric indices, and blink colors. Used for display attributes and matching elements by color.

## Dependencies

- `zss/mapping/types` — MAYBE, isarray, isnumber, ispresent, isstring
- `./reader` — READ_CONTEXT
- `./types` — COLOR, NAME, WORD

## Exports

| Export | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `colortofg` | COLOR → fg index (undefined for bg/blink) |
| `colortobg` | COLOR → bg index (ONBLACK…ONCLEAR range) |
| `colorconsts` | String → STR_COLOR_CONST mapping (black, onblack, blblack, etc.) |
| `isstrcolor` | Type guard for STR_COLOR |
| `isbgstrcolor` | True if STR_COLOR starts with ON |
| `mapstrcolor` | Maps string to STR_COLOR_CONST or undefined |
| `mapcolortostrcolor` | (fg, bg) → [STR_COLOR_CONST, STR_COLOR_CONST] |
| `readstrcolor` | STR_COLOR → first fg COLOR |
| `readstrbg` | STR_COLOR → first bg COLOR |
| `readcolor(index)` | Returns `[STR_COLOR | undefined, nextIndex]` |
| `mapstrcolortoattributes` | STR_COLOR → `{ color?, bg? }` |
| `iscolormatch` | (pattern, color, bg) → boolean |

## readcolor Logic

1. If word is numeric → parse as color index; return mapcolortostrcolor
2. Read fg color const (optional)
3. Read bg color const (optional, must be on*)
4. Return combined STR_COLOR or `[undefined, index]`

## Aliases

brown→DKYELLOW, dkwhite→LTGRAY, gray/grey→LTGRAY, dkgrey→DKGRAY, ltblack→DKGRAY; on* and bl* variants.

---

# dir.ts
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/words/dir

**Purpose**: Parses direction values from word arrays. Supports cardinal directions, modifiers (cw, ccw, opp), pathfinding (away, toward, find, flee), and compound dirs with args (by x y, at x y, within n, awayby n). Used for movement and spatial queries.

## Dependencies

- `zss/mapping/types` — MAYBE, isarray, ispresent, isstring
- `./kind` — STR_KIND (for STR_DIR type)
- `./reader` — ARG_TYPE, READ_CONTEXT, readargs
- `./types` — DIR, NAME, PT, WORD

## Exports

| Export | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `dirconsts` | String → STR_DIR_CONST mapping |
| `ispt` | Type guard for PT |
| `ptapplydir` | Mutates pt by cardinal direction |
| `dirfromdelta` | (dx, dy) → DIR (cardinal) |
| `dirfrompts` | (last, current) → DIR |
| `mapstrdir` | Maps string to STR_DIR_CONST or undefined |
| `mapstrdirtoconst` | STR_DIR/string → DIR enum |
| `isstrdir` | Type guard for STR_DIR |
| `readdir(index)` | Returns `[STR_DIR | undefined, nextIndex]` |
| `EVAL_DIR` | `{ dir, startpt, destpt, layer, targets }` |

## STR_DIR Format

Array of STR_DIR_CONST, STR_KIND, numbers, and strings. Modifiers (CW, CCW, OPP, etc.) can be followed by more dirs. Direction args:

| Dir | Args |
|-----|------|
| BY, AT, AWAY, TOWARD | x, y (numbers) |
| FIND, FLEE | kind |
| TO | dir1, dir2 (combined dest) |
| WITHIN, AWAYBY | amount (number) |
| SELECT | selectmode (string), kind |

## readdir Logic

1. Read dir const(s); mods (CW, CCW, OVER, etc.) allow more dirs
2. For BY/AT/AWAY/TOWARD: read two numbers
3. For FIND/FLEE: read kind
4. For TO: read two dirs; combine destpts relative to element
5. For WITHIN/AWAYBY: read number
6. For SELECT: read selectmode (string) and kind
7. Return STR_DIR or `[undefined, index]`

---

# expr.ts
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/words/expr

**Purpose**: Evaluates expressions from word arrays. Handles categories, collisions, colors, directions, and built-in expressions (aligned, contact, blocked, any, countof, abs, min, max, pick, random, run, etc.). Delegates to memory for board queries. Used when commands need computed values.

## Dependencies

- `zss/mapping/array` — pick, pickwith
- `zss/mapping/number` — clamp, randominteger, randomintegerwith
- `zss/mapping/types` — MAYBE, isarray, isnumber, ispresent, isstring
- `zss/memory` — memoryreadboardbyevaldir
- `zss/memory/boardmovement` — memorycheckmoveboardobject
- `zss/memory/boardaccess` — memoryreadelement, memoryreadterrain, memorylistelement (color / group / kind)
- `zss/words/kind` — readkind (any/countof prefer registered kind names before group)
- `zss/memory/bookoperations` — memoryreadelementdisplay
- `zss/memory/runtime` — memoryruncodepage
- `zss/memory/spatialqueries` — memoryfindplayerforelement
- `zss/memory/boardlifecycle` — memoryelementmatchesstrgrouponboard (soft name / `@group` match)
- `zss/memory/types` — BOARD_ELEMENT
- `./category` — isstrcategory, mapstrcategory, readcategory
- `./collision` — isstrcollision, mapstrcollision, readcollision
- `./color` — isstrcolor, mapstrcolor, readcolor, readstrbg, readstrcolor
- `./dir` — isstrdir, mapstrdir, readdir
- `./group` — isstrgroup, readstrgroupcolor, readstrgroupname
- `./reader` — ARG_TYPE, READ_CONTEXT, readargs
- `./send` — parsesend
- `./types` — DIR, NAME

## Exports

| Export | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `readexpr(index)` | Returns `[value, nextIndex]` |

## Expression Categories

### Category, Collision, Color, Dir

If word maps to category/collision/color/dir → delegate to readcategory, readcollision, readcolor, readdir.

### ZZT-style Flags

| Expr | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `aligned`, `alligned` | 1 if element aligned (same row/col) with player |
| `contact` | 1 if element adjacent to player |
| `blocked` dir | 1 if movement blocked in direction |
| `pget` dir attr | Remote attr (`id`, `x`/`y`, `p*`, `step`/`shoot` as dir, `light` as radius, …); 0 if missing |

### ZZT-style Queries

| Expr | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `any` kind/color/group | Registered kind name first (codepage / `empty`), else group or color |
| `any` dir kind/color/group | Element at dir dest; kind matches `element.kind`, not `@isbreakable` |
| `countof` kind/color/group | Count of matching elements |
| `countof` dir kind/color/group | 1/0 if element at dir matches |

When `breakable` is a loaded terrain kind, `any dir breakable` is ZZT `E_BREAKABLE` (kind name). A gem with `@isbreakable` does not match. If that kind is not loaded, `readkind` fails and group/stat matching still applies.

### Numeric

| Expr | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `rnd` | 0 or 1 |
| `rnd` n | 0 to n |
| `rnd` min max | min to max |
| `abs` a | Math.abs; a may be a full arith expression |
| `intceil`, `intfloor`, `intround` | Math variants; arg may be a full arith expression |
| `intsign` a | -1, 0, or 1 from sign of a; a may be a full arith expression |
| `clamp` a min max | clamp; each slot may be a full arith expression |
| `min`, `max` | Math.min/max over args; each arg may be a full arith expression |
| `pick` … | random pick from args |
| `pickwith` seed … | deterministic pick |
| `random` a [b] | random integer |
| `randomwith` seed a [b] | deterministic random |

Nested unaries without parens are valid (`intsign abs p1`, `intsign abs playery - thisy`). Multi-arg slots each consume one arith expression, so `min a + b c` is `min(a+b, c)`; use parens to separate: `min (a + b) (c + d)`.

### Advanced

| Expr | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `run` name | Run codepage; return get('arg') |
| `runwith` arg name | Set element.arg, run codepage, return get('arg') |

### Flags

If READ_CONTEXT.get(name) returns a value → use it (chip variables).

## readvargs

Internal: reads variable args until `|` or max count; used for min, max, pick, etc.

---

# kind.ts
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/words/kind

**Purpose**: Parses kind values — element name with optional color prefix. Validates names against memory (memoryreadelementkind). Used when commands target elements by kind (e.g. any, countof, find).

## Dependencies

- `zss/mapping/types` — MAYBE, isarray, ispresent, isstring
- `zss/memory` — memoryreadelementkind
- `./color` — colortobg, readcolor, readstrbg, readstrcolor
- `./reader` — READ_CONTEXT
- `./types` — COLOR, WORD

## Exports

| Export | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `STR_KIND` | `[string, STR_COLOR?]` — name and optional color |
| `isstrkind` | Type guard for STR_KIND |
| `strkindtostr` | STR_KIND → string[] (color consts then name) |
| `readname(index)` | Returns `[string | undefined, nextIndex]` |
| `readkind(index)` | Returns `[STR_KIND | undefined, nextIndex]` |
| `readstrkindname` | STR_KIND → name |
| `readstrkindcolor` | STR_KIND → fg COLOR |
| `readstrkindbg` | STR_KIND → bg COLOR |

## readkind Logic

1. If word is already STR_KIND → return it
2. Try readcolor (optional), then readname
3. Validate name: `empty` or memoryreadelementkind({ kind: name })
4. Return `[[name, color], nextIndex]` or `[undefined, index]`

---

# printvalue.ts
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/words/printvalue

**Purpose**: Display stringify for `$name` / `${name}` template expansion in scroll text and double-quoted strings (`#set "${color}key"`, etc.).

## Export

| Export | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `formatprintvalue(value, name?)` | Returns a printable string/number/boolean for chip `print` / `template` |

## Behavior

- **Name-hinted numeric stats**: `color` / `bg` / `displaycolor` / `displaybg` → `COLOR[n].toLowerCase()`; `collision` → `COLLISION[n]`; `category` → `CATEGORY[n]`
- **Typed arrays**: `STR_COLOR`, `STR_COLLISION`, `STR_CATEGORY`, `STR_DIR` (nested `STR_GROUP` formatted), KIND/GROUP `[name, STR_COLOR?]`
- **Const strings** from firmware `maptoconst` (`BLUE`, `NORTH`, `ISWALK`, …) → lowercase
- Other numbers/strings unchanged; unknown arrays/objects keep the old `array N items` / `obj …` labels

Without a name hint, `9` stays `9` (so `$char` / `$cycle` are not treated as colors).

---

# reader.ts
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/words/reader

**Purpose**: Defines READ_CONTEXT and readargs — the argument parsing engine. READ_CONTEXT holds runtime state (book, board, element, words, get). readargs parses a word array from an index given a sequence of ARG_TYPEs and returns typed values plus the next index.

## Dependencies

- `zss/mapping/types` — MAYBE, isnumber, isstring
- `zss/memory/boarddirection` — memoryevaldir
- `zss/memory/types` — BOARD, BOARD_ELEMENT, BOOK
- `./color` — STR_COLOR, mapcolortostrcolor, readcolor
- `./dir` — EVAL_DIR, readdir
- `./expr` — readexpr
- `./kind` — STR_KIND, isstrkind, readkind

## Exports

| Export | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `READ_CONTEXT` | Mutable context: timestamp, book, board, element, elementid, elementisplayer, elementfocus, words, get, haslabel |
| `ARG_TYPE` | Enum of expected argument types |
| `ARG_TYPE_MAP` | Maps ARG_TYPE to concrete types |
| `readargs(words, index, args)` | Parses args; returns `[...values, nextIndex]` |

## ARG_TYPE Values

| Type | Maps To |
|------|---------|
| `COLOR` | STR_COLOR |
| `KIND` | STR_KIND |
| `DIR` | EVAL_DIR |
| `NAME` | string |
| `NUMBER` | number |
| `STRING` | string |
| `NUMBER_OR_STRING` | number \| string |
| `COLOR_OR_GROUP` | STR_COLOR \| STR_GROUP |
| `GROUP` | STR_GROUP |
| `MAYBE_KIND` | MAYBE\<STR_KIND\> |
| `MAYBE_GROUP` | MAYBE\<STR_GROUP\> |
| `MAYBE_NAME` | MAYBE\<string\> |
| `MAYBE_NUMBER` | MAYBE\<number\> |
| `MAYBE_STRING` | MAYBE\<string\> |
| `MAYBE_NUMBER_OR_STRING` | MAYBE\<number \| string\> |
| `ANY` | any |

## readargs Behavior

- Temporarily sets `READ_CONTEXT.words` to the supplied `words`
- For DIR: evaluates via `memoryevaldir` to produce destpt, layer, targets
- For COLOR: uses readexpr if not a color const; supports numeric color
- For COLOR_OR_GROUP: color const first, else `readgroup` (freeform name + optional color prefix)
- On invalid arg: calls `didexpect` (throws with context)

## Internal Helpers

- **`readdestfromdir`** — Calls memoryevaldir with element position and dir; returns EVAL_DIR

---

# Words Documentation
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/words/README

The words system provides parsing and evaluation for the ZSS scripting vocabulary — categories, colors, directions, kinds, expressions, stats, and send syntax. It is used at runtime when commands execute and need to read arguments from parsed word arrays.

## Architecture Overview

The system centers on **READ_CONTEXT** and **readargs**:

- **READ_CONTEXT** — Holds book, board, element, words, and `get` for flag lookups
- **readargs** — Parses a word array from an index given an expected type sequence (COLOR, KIND, DIR, NUMBER, etc.)

Domain-specific readers (`readcategory`, `readcolor`, `readdir`, `readkind`) consume words and return `[value, nextIndex]`. The **expr** module evaluates expressions (any, countof, blocked, aligned, run, etc.) and delegates to memory/board operations.

## Module Index

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| [types.md](types.md) | Enums (COLOR, COLLISION, CATEGORY, DIR, STAT_TYPE) and base types |
| [reader.md](reader.md) | READ_CONTEXT, readargs, ARG_TYPE |
| [category.md](category.md) | Category parsing (isterrain, isobject) |
| [collision.md](collision.md) | Collision parsing (iswalk, issolid, etc.) |
| [color.md](color.md) | Color parsing and mapping |
| [dir.md](dir.md) | Direction parsing with args (by, at, find, flee, etc.) |
| [kind.md](kind.md) | Kind parsing (name + optional color) |
| [expr.md](expr.md) | Expression evaluation (aligned, any, countof, blocked, run, etc.) |
| [send.md](send.md) | Send/message parsing (target:label args) |
| [stats.md](stats.md) | Stat format parsing (loader, board, range, select, etc.) |
| [textformat.md](textformat.md) | Text formatting with colors, $flags, and layout |
| [printvalue.md](printvalue.md) | `$name` display stringify (COLOR/DIR/KIND/GROUP/COLLISION/CATEGORY) |
| [system.md](system.md) | Platform detection (ismac, metakey) |

## Data Flow

```
command words
    → readargs(words, index, [ARG_TYPE.KIND, ARG_TYPE.DIR, …])
    → readkind / readdir / readcolor / readexpr / …
    → READ_CONTEXT.board, element, get
    → memory* (boardaccess, boardlifecycle, boards, spatialqueries, runtime, …)
    → evaluated values
```

---

# send.ts
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/words/send

**Purpose**: Parses send/message syntax from word arrays. Supports `target:label args`, `label args`, and directional send `dir :label args`. Used by loader and runtime for dispatching messages to elements.

## Dependencies

- `zss/mapping/types` — isstring
- `./dir` — EVAL_DIR, isstrdir
- `./reader` — ARG_TYPE, readargs
- `./types` — WORD

## Exports

| Export | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `SEND_META` | `{ targetdir?, targetname?, label, args }` |
| `parsesend(words, candirsend?)` | Returns SEND_META |

## Parsing Modes

### Directional Send (candirsend=true, first arg is dir)

| Pattern | Result |
|---------|--------|
| `dir :label args` | targetdir=dir, label=label (without :), args=rest |
| `dir label args` | targetdir=dir, label=label, args=rest |

### Named Send

| Pattern | Result |
|---------|--------|
| `target:label args` | targetname=target, label=label (without :), args=rest |
| `label args` | targetname='self', label=first word, args=rest |

## Fallback

Returns `{ targetname: '', label: '', args: [] }` if parsing fails.

---

# stats.ts
Source: https://zed.cafe/docs/words/stats

**Purpose**: Parses and formats stat declarations from `@` lines. Maps stat types (loader, board, object, range, select, number, etc.) to STAT_TYPE and value arrays. Used when loading codepages and interpreting stat metadata.

## Dependencies

- `./types` — NAME, STAT_TYPE

## Exports

| Export | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `statformat(label, words, first?)` | Returns `{ type: STAT_TYPE, values: string[] }` |
| `stattypestring(type)` | STAT_TYPE → string name |

## statformat Modes

### First stat (first=true)

| First word | type | values |
|------------|------|--------|
| loader | LOADER | rest |
| board | BOARD | rest |
| object | OBJECT | rest |
| terrain | TERRAIN | rest |
| charset | CHARSET | rest |
| palette | PALETTE | rest |
| default | OBJECT | all words |

### Subsequent stats (first=false)

| Second word | type | values |
|-------------|------|--------|
| rn, range | RANGE | [target, label, …] |
| sl, select | SELECT | [target, label, …] |
| nm, number | NUMBER | [target, label, …] |
| tx, text | TEXT | [target, label, …] |
| hk, hotkey | HOTKEY | [target, label, …] |
| copyit | COPYIT | rest |
| openit | OPENIT | rest |
| viewit | VIEWIT | rest |
| runit | RUNIT | rest |
| zssedit | ZSSEDIT | rest |
| charedit | CHAREDIT | rest |
| coloredit | COLOREDIT | rest |
| default | CONST | all words |
